You have downloaded an OLab zip file. See the second zip file contained within this download. Extract it and save it as a single zip file.

Participant Simulator for TTalk sessions in OLab4. 
The software allows you to stress test your server and network setup to see how it will handle multiple concurrent conversations, conducted via the TTalk service.
